meta.project: ProTick CBT Student Portal - Frontend Testing

product_overview: ProTick CBT Student Portal is an offline-first computer-based testing frontend for a 30-question academic exam. It covers the full candidate journey from identity verification and waiting-room gating through timed answering, submission review, and locked post-submission confirmation.
core_goals: Authenticate a student candidate using USN and DOB before exam access
Present synchronized pre-exam instructions and enforce mandatory consent before starting
Support secure timed exam-taking with autosave, anti-defocus monitoring, and question navigation
Provide a review and submission workflow with irreversible confirmation safeguards
Display a locked post-submission receipt and audit state after final submission
Allow testers and examiners to jump between screens for UI verification

features.name: Authorized Student Login
features.description: Allows a candidate to enter a 10-digit University Seat Number and date of birth for offline credential verification, with an option to alert the invigilator for assistance.
user_flows: GET /login view state -> Enter a valid 10-character USN and valid DOB -> Click Login to Examination -> Receive offline verification success state -> Transition to View 2 instructions screen
GET /login view state -> Enter invalid or incomplete USN/DOB -> Click Login to Examination -> Receive validation failure or disabled action state -> Remain on login screen
GET /login view state -> Click Call Invigilator -> Open assistance modal -> Confirm notification sent for Terminal WS-19
GET /login view state -> Enter fewer than 10 USN characters -> Observe neutral checkmark status -> Attempt login -> Receive blocked or unverified state

features.name: Instruction & Waiting Page
features.description: Shows candidate identity details, terminal assignment, countdown to release, exam rules, and consent gating before the exam can start.
user_flows: GET /instructions view state -> Receive candidate card with name, USN, terminal, and IP -> Watch countdown reach zero or use Release Paper Now -> Check consent box -> Click Start Examination -> Transition to View 3 exam workspace
GET /instructions view state -> Countdown is still active -> Check consent box -> Click Start Examination -> Receive disabled or blocked start state -> Stay on instructions page
GET /instructions view state -> View code of conduct and proctor signature badge -> Accept consent requirement -> Wait for countdown completion -> Click Start Examination -> Launch the exam
GET /instructions view state -> Toggle Release Paper Now -> Countdown bypasses immediately -> Check consent box -> Click Start Examination -> Begin exam session

features.name: Main Examination Workspace
features.description: Provides the timed 30-question exam interface with multiple-choice answers, autosave sync status, anti-cheat defocus logging, question matrix navigation, and progress toward submission.
user_flows: GET /exam view state -> Load Question 1 of 30 with prompt and options -> Select an answer option -> Click Save & Next -> Receive updated autosave status and advance to next question
GET /exam view state -> Switch browser tab or blur window -> Trigger visibilitychange or blur event -> Receive security incident logged banner -> Return to exam without losing state
GET /exam view state -> Click Mark Review on a question -> Receive purple review status -> Open 30-question matrix palette -> Click a different numbered question -> Navigate directly to that question
GET /exam view state -> Attempt Previous on Question 1 -> Receive disabled navigation control -> Stay on Question 1
GET /exam view state -> Click Emergency Final Submit -> Receive progress summary -> Transition to Review Dashboard
GET /exam view state -> Submit with an unanswered question state -> Receive incomplete progress still reflected in matrix and tallies -> Proceed toward review rather than direct finalization

features.name: Review & Submit Dashboard
features.description: Summarizes answered, unanswered, and marked-for-review items, then requires explicit confirmation before irreversible final submission.
user_flows: GET /review dashboard state -> Receive answered/unanswered/review tallies and palette overview -> Click Proceed to Examination Submission -> Open irreversible confirmation modal -> Click Confirm Final Submission -> Trigger encrypted submission flow and move to View 5
GET /review dashboard state -> Click Proceed to Examination Submission -> Open confirmation modal -> Click Cancel & Return to Exam -> Close modal and return to exam workspace
GET /review dashboard state -> Click Jump to Matrix -> Return directly to the exam workspace matrix view -> Continue editing responses

GET /review dashboard state -> Attempt final submission with unresolved unanswered questions -> Review tallies remain visible -> Open confirmation modal and verify irreversible warning before confirming

features.name: Post-Submission Hard-Locked Kiosk
features.description: Displays the final locked submission state with audit hash, verified response ledger, celebratory confirmation, and navigation restrictions after exam completion.
user_flows: GET /post-submission view state -> Receive locked kiosk header and submission emblem -> View audit hash and verified response ledger -> Observe confetti confirmation and locked completion state
GET /post-submission view state -> Attempt refresh, back navigation, or inspect actions -> Receive blocked navigation behavior -> Remain on locked kiosk screen
GET /post-submission view state -> Click Reset Demo -> Restart session -> Return to View 1 login screen
GET /post-submission view state -> Review cryptographic receipt card -> Verify session hash and synced response count -> Confirm exam submission is complete

features.name: Stitch Screens Switcher
features.description: Provides a persistent bottom dock for switching between the five screens or resetting the session for rapid UI testing and demonstration.
user_flows: GET /app shell -> Use bottom dock to select any of the 5 views -> Load the chosen screen instantly -> Continue testing across views
GET /app shell -> Use bottom dock reset action -> Clear current session state -> Return to View 1 login screen
GET /app shell -> Select View 3 exam screen from the dock -> Navigate directly to the exam workspace -> Continue response testing
GET /app shell -> Select View 5 post-submission screen from the dock without completing prior steps -> Display locked completion UI for design verification

libraries: Google Fonts (Inter, JetBrains Mono, Material Symbols Outlined)

features.name: Authorized Student Login
features.description: Candidate enters 10-digit University Seat Number (USN) and Date of Birth (DOB) with offline credential validation and invigilator summon modal.

features.name: Instruction & Waiting Page
features.description: Displays candidate identification passport portrait, assigned lab terminal and IP, synchronized countdown clock to scheduled release, code of conduct rules, and mandatory consent acknowledgement.

features.name: Main Examination Workspace
features.description: Timed testing HUD, window defocus anti-cheat incident logging, question problem prompt with Floyd-Warshall dynamic programming formulation, accessible A-D multiple choice options, sticky navigation controls (Previous, Mark Review, Save & Next), and interactive 30-question status matrix palette.

features.name: Review & Submit Dashboard
features.description: Detailed reconciliation breakdown for Answered, Unanswered, and Marked for Review questions with palette overview, local SQLite SHA-256 sync status, and secure confirmation dialog with irreversible submission warning.

features.name: Post-Submission Hard-Locked Kiosk
features.description: Displays locked kiosk authority header, celebratory confetti animation, cryptographic audit hash (HASH-98F2-A109-CS602-SECURE), verified response ledger, proctor directive, and keyboard navigation locks.

features.name: Stitch Screens Switcher
features.description: Persistent bottom dock allowing testers and examiners to switch between any of the 5 Stitch screens or reset the session.
